verdict.rationale: A system-to-system filing or data channel is a fair question for a national IP office, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing channels: online filing behind a One Login personal credential, email or post forms, and web search tools. There is no documented API, system account, transmitter or batch-provider programme, and no published enrollment path for one. The probe also shows the trade-mark search host blocks automated agents at robots.txt.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
